verses.en: Then sang Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam on that day, saying,
verses.pt: E aquele dia cantou Débora, com Baraque, filho de Abinoão, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Then Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam sang on that day, saying,
verses.en_bbe: At that time Deborah and Barak, the son of Abinoam, made this song, saying:

verses.en: Praise ye the LORD for the avenging of Israel, when the people willingly offered themselves.
verses.pt: Porque vingou as injúrias de Israel, Porque o povo se ofereceu de sua vontade, Louvai ao SENHOR.
verses.en_web: “Because the leaders took the lead in Israel, because the people offered themselves willingly, be blessed, Yahweh!
verses.en_bbe: Because of the flowing hair of the fighters in Israel, because the people gave themselves freely, give praise to the Lord.

verses.en: Hear, O ye kings; give ear, O ye princes; I, even I, will sing unto the LORD; I will sing praise to the LORD God of Israel.
verses.pt: Ouvi, reis; estai atentos, ó príncipes: Eu cantarei ao SENHOR, Cantarei salmos ao SENHOR Deus de Israel.
verses.en_web: “Hear, you kings! Give ear, you princes! I, even I, will sing to Yahweh. I will sing praise to Yahweh, the God of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: Give attention, O kings; give ear, O rulers; I, even I, will make a song to the Lord; I will make melody to the Lord, the God of Israel.

verses.en: LORD, when thou wentest out of Seir, when thou marchedst out of the field of Edom, the earth trembled, and the heavens dropped, the clouds also dropped water.
verses.pt: Quando saíste de Seir, ó SENHOR, Quando te apartaste do campo de Edom, A terra tremeu, e os céus destilaram, E as nuvens gotejaram águas.
verses.en_web: “Yahweh, when you went out of Seir, when you marched out of the field of Edom, the earth trembled, the sky also dropped. Yes, the clouds dropped water.
verses.en_bbe: Lord, when you went out from Seir, moving like an army from the field of Edom, the earth was shaking and the heavens were troubled, and the clouds were dropping water.

verses.en: The mountains melted from before the LORD, even that Sinai from before the LORD God of Israel.
verses.pt: Os montes se derreteram diante do SENHOR, Até o Sinai, diante do SENHOR Deus de Israel.
verses.en_web: The mountains quaked Yahweh’s presence, even Sinai at the presence of Yahweh, the God of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: The mountains were shaking before the Lord, before the Lord, the God of Israel.

verses.en: In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were unoccupied, and the travelers walked through byways.
verses.pt: Em os dias de Sangar filho de Anate, Em os dias de Jael, cessaram os caminhos, E os que andavam pelas sendas apartavam-se por veredas torcidas.
verses.en_web: “In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were unoccupied. The travelers walked through byways.
verses.en_bbe: In the days of Shamgar, the son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were not used, and travellers went by side roads.

verses.en: The inhabitants of the villages ceased, they ceased in Israel, until that I Deborah arose, that I arose a mother in Israel.
verses.pt: As aldeias haviam cessado em Israel, haviam decaído; Até que eu Débora me levantei, Me levantei mãe em Israel.
verses.en_web: The rulers ceased in Israel. They ceased until I, Deborah, arose; Until I arose a mother in Israel.
verses.en_bbe: Country towns were no more in Israel, *** were no more, till you, Deborah, came up, till you came up as a mother in Israel.

verses.en: They chose new gods; then was war in the gates: was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel?
verses.pt: Em escolhendo novos deuses, A guerra estava às portas: Se via escudo ou lança Entre quarenta mil em Israel?
verses.en_web: They chose new gods. Then war was in the gates. Was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel?
verses.en_bbe: They had no one to make arms, there were no more armed men in the towns; was there a body-cover or a spear to be seen among forty thousand in Israel?

verses.en: My heart is toward the governors of Israel, that offered themselves willingly among the people. Bless ye the LORD.
verses.pt: Meu coração está pelos líderes de Israel, Os que com boa vontade se ofereceram entre o povo: Louvai ao SENHOR.
verses.en_web: My heart is toward the governors of Israel, who offered themselves willingly among the people. Bless Yahweh!
verses.en_bbe: Come, you rulers of Israel, you who gave yourselves freely among the people: give praise to the Lord.

verses.en: Speak, ye that ride on white asses, ye that sit in judgment, and walk by the way.
verses.pt: Vós os que cavalgais em asnas brancas, Os que presidis em juízo, E vós os que viajais, falai.
verses.en_web: “Speak, you who ride on white donkeys, you who sit on rich carpets, and you who walk by the way.
verses.en_bbe: Let them give thought to it, who go on white asses, and those who are walking on the road.

verses.en: They that are delivered from the noise of archers in the places of drawing water, there shall they rehearse the righteous acts of the LORD, even the righteous acts toward the inhabitants of his villages in Israel: then shall the people of the LORD go down to the gates.
verses.pt: Longe do ruído dos arqueiros, nos bebedouros, Ali repetirão as justiças do SENHOR, As justiças de suas vilas em Israel; Então o povo do SENHOR desceu às portas.
verses.en_web: Far from the noise of archers, in the places of drawing water, there they will rehearse Yahweh’s righteous acts, the righteous acts of his rule in Israel. “Then Yahweh’s people went down to the gates.
verses.en_bbe: Give ear to the women laughing by the water-springs; there they will give again the story of the upright acts of the Lord, all the upright acts of his arm in Israel.

verses.en: Awake, awake, Deborah: awake, awake, utter a song: arise, Barak, and lead thy captivity captive, thou son of Abinoam.
verses.pt: Desperta, desperta, Débora; Desperta, desperta, profere um cântico. Levanta-te, Baraque, e leva teus cativos, filho de Abinoão.
verses.en_web: ‘Awake, awake, Deborah! Awake, awake, utter a song! Arise, Barak, and lead away your captives, you son of Abinoam.’
verses.en_bbe: Awake! awake! Deborah: awake! awake! give a song: Up! Barak, and take prisoner those who took you prisoner, O son of Abinoam.

verses.en: Then he made him that remaineth have dominion over the nobles among the people: the LORD made me have dominion over the mighty.
verses.pt: Então fez que o que restou do povo, senhoreie aos poderosos: o SENHOR me fez senhorear sobre os fortes.
verses.en_web: “Then a remnant of the nobles and the people came down. Yahweh came down for me against the mighty.
verses.en_bbe: Then the chiefs went down to the doors; the Lord's people went down among the strong ones.

verses.en: Out of Ephraim was there a root of them against Amalek; after thee, Benjamin, among thy people; out of Machir came down governors, and out of Zebulun they that handle the pen of the writer.
verses.pt: De Efraim saiu sua raiz contra Amaleque, Depois ti, Benjamim, contra teus povos; De Maquir desceram príncipes, E de Zebulom os que costumavam manejar vara de oficial.
verses.en_web: Those whose root is in Amalek came out of Ephraim, after you, Benjamin, among your peoples. Governors come down out of Machir. Those who handle the marshal’s staff came out of Zebulun.
verses.en_bbe: Out of Ephraim they came down into the valley; after you, Benjamin, among your tribesmen; from Machir came down the captains, and from Zebulun those in whose hand is the ruler's rod.

verses.en: And the princes of Issachar were with Deborah; even Issachar, and also Barak: he was sent on foot into the valley. For the divisions of Reuben there were great thoughts of heart.
verses.pt: Príncipes também de Issacar foram com Débora; E como Issacar, também Baraque Se pôs a pé no vale. Das divisões de Rúben houve grandes impressões do coração.
verses.en_web: The princes of Issachar were with Deborah. As was Issachar, so was Barak. They rushed into the valley at his feet. By the watercourses of Reuben, there were great resolves of heart.
verses.en_bbe: Your chiefs, Issachar, were with Deborah; and Naphtali was true to Barak; into the valley they went rushing out at his feet. In Reuben there were divisions, and great searchings of heart.

verses.en: Why abodest thou among the sheepfolds, to hear the bleatings of the flocks? For the divisions of Reuben there were great searchings of heart.
verses.pt: Por que te restaste entre os currais, Para ouvir os balidos dos rebanhos? Das divisões de Rúben Grandes foram os questionamentos do coração.
verses.en_web: Why did you sit among the sheepfolds? To hear the whistling for the flocks? At the watercourses of Reuben, there were great searchings of heart.
verses.en_bbe: Why did you keep quiet among the sheep, hearing nothing but the watchers piping to the flocks?

verses.en: Gilead abode beyond Jordan: and why did Dan remain in ships? Asher continued on the sea shore, and abode in his breaches.
verses.pt: Gileade se restou da outra parte do Jordão: E Dã por que se esteve junto aos navios? Manteve-se Aser à beira do mar, E ficou em seus portos.
verses.en_web: Gilead lived beyond the Jordan. Why did Dan remain in ships? Asher sat still at the haven of the sea, and lived by his creeks.
verses.en_bbe: Gilead was living over Jordan; and Dan was waiting in his ships; Asher kept in his place by the sea's edge, living by his inlets.

verses.en: Zebulun and Naphtali were a people that jeoparded their lives unto the death in the high places of the field.
verses.pt: O povo de Zebulom expôs sua vida à morte, E Naftali nas alturas do campo.
verses.en_web: Zebulun was a people that jeopardized their lives to the death; Naphtali also, on the high places of the field.
verses.en_bbe: It was the people of Zebulun who put their lives in danger, even to death, with Naphtali on the high places of the field.

verses.en: The kings came and fought, then fought the kings of Canaan in Taanach by the waters of Megiddo; they took no gain of money.
verses.pt: Vieram reis e lutaram: Então lutaram os reis de Canaã Em Taanaque, junto às águas de Megido, Mas não levaram despojo algum de dinheiro.
verses.en_web: “The kings came and fought, then the kings of Canaan fought at Taanach by the waters of Megiddo. They took no plunder of silver.
verses.en_bbe: The kings came on to the fight, the kings of Canaan were warring; in Taanach by the waters of Megiddo: they took no profit in money.

verses.en: They fought from heaven; the stars in their courses fought against Sisera.
verses.pt: Dos céus lutaram: As estrelas desde suas órbitas lutaram contra Sísera.
verses.en_web: From the sky the stars fought. From their courses, they fought against Sisera.
verses.en_bbe: The stars from heaven were fighting; from their highways they were fighting against Sisera.

verses.en: The river of Kishon swept them away, that ancient river, the river Kishon. O my soul, thou hast trodden down strength.
verses.pt: Varreu-os o ribeiro de Quisom, O antigo ribeiro, o ribeiro de Quisom. Pisaste, ó alma minha, com força.
verses.en_web: The river Kishon swept them away, that ancient river, the river Kishon. My soul, march on with strength.
verses.en_bbe: The river Kishon took them violently away, stopping their flight, the river Kishon. Give praise, O my soul, to the strength of the Lord!

verses.en: Then were the horsehoofs broken by the means of the pransings, the pransings of their mighty ones.
verses.pt: Espancaram-se então os cascos dos cavalos pelas arremetidas, pelos galopes de seus fortes cavalos.
verses.en_web: Then the horse hoofs stamped because of the prancing, the prancing of their strong ones.
verses.en_bbe: Then loudly the feet of the horses were sounding with the stamping, the stamping of their war-horses.

verses.en: Curse ye Meroz, said the angel of the LORD, curse ye bitterly the inhabitants thereof; because they came not to the help of the LORD, to the help of the LORD against the mighty.
verses.pt: Amaldiçoai a Meroz, disse o anjo do SENHOR: Amaldiçoai severamente a seus moradores, Porque não vieram em socorro ao SENHOR, Em socorro ao SENHOR contra os fortes.
verses.en_web: ‘Curse Meroz,’ said Yahweh’s angel. ‘Curse bitterly its inhabitants, because they didn’t come to help Yahweh, to help Yahweh against the mighty.’
verses.en_bbe: A curse, a curse on Meroz! said the angel of the Lord. A bitter curse on her townspeople! Because they came not to the help of the Lord, to the help of the Lord among the strong ones.

verses.en: Blessed above women shall Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite be, blessed shall she be above women in the tent.
verses.pt: Bendita seja entre as mulheres Jael, Mulher de Héber queneu; Sobre as mulheres bendita seja na tenda.
verses.en_web: “Jael shall be blessed above women, the wife of Heber the Kenite; blessed shall she be above women in the tent.
verses.en_bbe: Blessings be on Jael, more than on all women! Blessings greater than on any in the tents!

verses.en: He asked water, and she gave him milk; she brought forth butter in a lordly dish.
verses.pt: Ele pediu água, e deu-lhe ela leite; Em taça de nobres lhe apresentou manteiga.
verses.en_web: He asked for water. She gave him milk. She brought him butter in a lordly dish.
verses.en_bbe: His request was for water, she gave him milk; she put butter before him on a fair plate.

verses.en: She put her hand to the nail, and her right hand to the workmen’s hammer; and with the hammer she smote Sisera, she smote off his head, when she had pierced and stricken through his temples.
verses.pt: Sua mão estendeu à estaca, E sua direita a marreta de trabalhadores; E golpeou a Sísera, feriu sua cabeça, esmagou e atravessou suas têmporas.
verses.en_web: She put her hand to the tent peg, and her right hand to the workmen’s hammer. With the hammer she struck Sisera. She struck through his head. Yes, she pierced and struck through his temples.
verses.en_bbe: She put out her hand to the tent-pin, and her right hand to the workman's hammer; and she gave Sisera a blow, crushing his head, wounding and driving through his brow.

verses.en: At her feet he bowed, he fell, he lay down: at her feet he bowed, he fell: where he bowed, there he fell down dead.
verses.pt: Caiu encurvado entre seus pés, ficou estendido: Entre seus pés caiu encurvado; Onde se encurvou, ali caiu morto.
verses.en_web: At her feet he bowed, he fell, he lay. At her feet he bowed, he fell. Where he bowed, there he fell down dead.
verses.en_bbe: Bent at her feet he went down, he was stretched out; bent at her feet he went down; where he was bent down, there he went down in death.

verses.en: The mother of Sisera looked out at a window, and cried through the lattice, Why is his chariot so long in coming? why tarry the wheels of his chariots?
verses.pt: A mãe de Sísera olha à janela, E por entre as grades a vozes disse: Por que se detém seu carro, que não vem? Por que as rodas de seus carros se tardam?
verses.en_web: “Through the window she looked out, and cried: Sisera’s mother looked through the lattice. ‘Why is his chariot so long in coming? Why do the wheels of his chariots wait?’
verses.en_bbe: Looking out from the window she gave a cry, the mother of Sisera was crying out through the window, Why is his carriage so long in coming? When will the noise of his wheels be sounding?

verses.en: Her wise ladies answered her, yea, she returned answer to herself,
verses.pt: As mais avisadas de suas damas lhe respondiam; E ainda ela se respondia a si mesma.
verses.en_web: Her wise ladies answered her, Yes, she returned answer to herself,
verses.en_bbe: Her wise women gave answer to her, yes, she made answer again to herself,

verses.en: Have they not sped? have they not divided the prey; to every man a damsel or two; to Sisera a prey of divers colours, a prey of divers colours of needlework, of divers colours of needlework on both sides, meet for the necks of them that take the spoil?
verses.pt: Não acharam despojos, e os estão repartindo? A cada um uma moça, ou duas: Os despojos de cores para Sísera, Os despojos bordados de cores: A roupa de cor bordada de ambos os lados, para os pescoços dos que tomaram os despojos.
verses.en_web: ‘Have they not found, have they not divided the plunder? A lady, two ladies to every man; to Sisera a plunder of dyed garments, a plunder of dyed garments embroidered, of dyed garments embroidered on both sides, on the necks of the plunder?’
verses.en_bbe: Are they not getting, are they not parting the goods among them: a young girl or two to every man; and to Sisera robes of coloured needlework, worked in fair colours on this side and on that, for the neck of the queen?

verses.en: So let all thine enemies perish, O LORD: but let them that love him be as the sun when he goeth forth in his might. And the land had rest forty years.
verses.pt: Assim pereçam todos os teus inimigos, ó SENHOR: Mas os que lhe amam, sejam como o sol quando nasce em sua força. E a terra repousou quarenta anos.
verses.en_web: “So let all your enemies perish, Yahweh, but let those who love him be as the sun when it rises in its strength.” Then the land had rest forty years.
verses.en_bbe: So may destruction come on all your haters, O Lord; but let your lovers be like the sun going out in his strength. And for forty years the land had peace.
